from: "Subodha Charles, IEEE Student Activities Committee (SAC) Chair" <ieee@deliver.ieee.org>
subject: Welcome to IEEE
body: Hello Anwar, Welcome to IEEE! I am absolutely thrilled to welcome you to the world’s largest tech organization dedicated to advancing technology for humanity. By joining us today, you have unlocked immediate, elite access to a global network of innovators. Remember: Together, we make anything possible. Consider these emails your personal IEEE Membership Navigator. Think of us as your membership concierge—we will guide you through your benefits one step at a time so you can get the most out of your student experience without any overwhelm. To get started, let’s ensure you can access your IEEE account. Customize your IEEE profile: Update your settings so you only receive news and updates that matter to your career and education. Sign in to select your technical interests and choose the topics you want in your personalized monthly newsletter. [Update Your Preferences](https://www.ieee.org/profile/myprofile/myprofile.html?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) Once you sign in, you will be able to manage your profile, select your technical interests, and customize your experience. Keep an eye on your inbox over the next couple of weeks. We will be reaching out soon with an exclusive invitation to connect with your local Student Branch and peers right on your campus or in your area. We are so excited to support you as you take your first steps toward a successful future. Welcome to the global community! Cheers, Subodha Charles IEEE Student Activities Committee (SAC) Chair [Website](https://www.ieee.org//?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) | [Privacy Policy](https://www.ieee.org/security-privacy?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) | [Contact](https://www.ieee.org/about/contact?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) [Custom social icon](https://ieee-collabratec.ieee.org/?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/ieeememberexperience/?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ieeemembership/?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@IEEEMemberExperience?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ieeexp/?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup&hl=en) [ieee logo](https://www.ieee.org/?utm_source=&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=MMO_NMO2027ST&utm_id=ST&utm_content=1Awelcomeandaccountsetup) © 2026 IEEE – All rights reserved.
